CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Haleon (LSE/NYSE: HLN) is a globally leading consumer company that is solely focused on better everyday health. Haleon's product portfolio spans three major categories - Oral Health, Over-the-Counter (OTC), and Wellness. Its long-standing brands - such as Advil, Centrum, Excedrin, Parodontax, Sensodyne, Theraflu and TUMS - are built on trusted science, innovation, and deep human understanding.
